entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I placed about a month ago. I got a jersey, and I need to see about a return or an exchange.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. It's just the wrong size. I tried it on, and it's way too tight across the shoulders. I definitely need to exchange it for a larger size if possible.
Okay, thanks for clarifying. A sizing issue is something we can definitely help with. Do you have the order number handy?

Great, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 33 days ago. Since our standard apparel items have a 90-day return window, you are well within the timeframe for an exchange. I can start that process for you right now.

Excellent, that's great news. Now, since I have to package this one up and send it back, and wait for the new one, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase, just for the trouble?

I understand the request, and I'm glad we can get you the right size. Our policy allows for a straightforward exchange for a different size at no extra cost, but I'm not authorized to provide a discount code on top of the approved exchange.
I see. Not even a 10% off code? I'm a regular customer and was hoping for a little flexibility.

I do appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit, I really do. However, my system is only set up to process the exchange for the jersey itself. The best I can do is get the return label sent to your email immediately so there's no delay in getting you the jersey that fits perfectly.
Alright, that's fair. I had to try. Let's go ahead with the exchange then. I'll need a size Large instead of the Medium.

Perfect. I've just processed the exchange for a size Large. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just send the jersey that was too tight back to us, and we'll ship the new one out as soon as we receive it. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Have a great day and enjoy your new VeloFit gear!
